title: Quadratic character oracle
statement: Let $\ell\colon\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{F}_2$ and $q\colon\mathbb{F}_2^{n\times n}\to\mathbb{F}_2$. The oracle on the disjoint union of vectors and binary matrices returns $\ell(x)$ on a vector address $x$ and $q(M)$ on a matrix address $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ maps binary vectors of length $n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2$
